Costumed Mr. Pengi: Shredding the Slopes & The Enemy
Costumed Mr. Pengi: Captain of the Snowboard Team

Just when you thought it was safe to go back into the snow, Mr. Pengi returns—this time with a snowboard and a serious glow-up. Released in December 2024, the "Snowboarder" costume revitalizes one of the game's most iconic damage dealers. As a 5-star Ice hero, Costumed Mr. Pengi retains the chaotic "Herring Surprise" mechanic but updates it with modern stats and a deadlier chain reaction. He trades his military regalia for winter sports gear, proving that you can look cool while pummeling enemies with fish.

The "Captain of Snowboard Team" look is a fun, lighter take on the character. Gone is the stern, fish-toting soldier; in his place is a cool, confident penguin ready to shred. The visuals are crisp, with vibrant blues and teals that pop against the winter background. The artwork perfectly captures the "Fast" mana speed vibe—he looks like he's already in motion.

The trade-off (lower snipe, higher chain) heavily favors the costume. The strength of Pengi has always been the chain hits. Increasing that multiplier to 160% means that with a full board of minions, he isn't just chipping away at enemies; he's taking chunks out of them.

On a standard 5-minion setup (e.g., one summoner + Pengi), the costume deals significantly more total damage across the board. The decay on consecutive hits still applies, but starting from a higher percentage keeps the damage relevant for longer.
231 damage is a nice bonus that can finish off enemies left with 1 HP (a common frustration with the original).
Family Bonus, Passives, Aether Power & Unique Abilities
The Winter family bonus is unchanged, providing vital stats to minions.

This is a fantastic addition. Every time one of Pengi's minions hits an enemy, they inflict 416 Frost damage over 4 turns. This turns his minions into DoT machines, adding constant pressure even when his special isn't firing.
A simple but effective boost. For a damage dealer whose main gimmick is hitting as many times as possible, more raw Attack is always the best choice.
The costume was released to bring Pengi back into the meta after his base stats became too low to compete.

If you are lucky enough to pull the costume, level this hero immediately. The costume bonus makes the base hero usable, but the costume itself is a legitimate carry hero that can win raids you have no business winning.

Costumed Pengi is a great "tool" hero. He isn't your everyday defense hero anymore, but for Minion Wars or specific offensive raid teams, he remains top-tier. He is worth the Limit Break if you already have a strong supporting cast of minion summoners (e.g., Waterpipe, Leadria, M&M).

Costumed Mr. Pengi proves that you can teach an old bird new tricks. By trading raw snipe power for devastating chain potential and the elusive Rogue class, he has secured his spot in the roster for years to come. He may look ridiculous in his goggles, but when that 160% chain starts flying, the only one laughing will be you.
A must-have for minion lovers and Titan smashers. The snowboard isn't just for show—he's here to shred.
